decisions.reason: Having already been retained once, this regional electricity tariff calculator now carries additional sunk development effort and public commitment while remaining tightly aligned with the firm's core tariff-calculation platform.
As a multi-model product line in a central calculation domain, it is strategically important enough that management is likely to justify continued support and treat any weak uptake as temporary.

Although somewhat more of an enabling component than a headline offer, the area definition tool supports the firm's integrated platform direction and its prior standalone presentation raises the reputational cost of withdrawal.

This site-specific energy tariff comparison line is close to the established offer, has accumulated further commitment by surviving into a second cycle, and is likely to be viewed as worth refining rather than abandoning.
